thread:
maya: Quick Q — where's the Grafana panel for KV / prefix cache hit-rate in prod? I noticed a dip around 00:30-00:50 UTC and want dashboards + any logs/traces we should check. Anyone own the alerts for this?

oliver: Dashboard is here: https://grafana.redwood.team/d/kv-cache/kv-prefix-overview?orgId=1 
Main panels: overall hit-rate, hit-rate by prefix pattern, per-tenant hit-rate heatmap, and eviction rate.

kevin: Quick PromQL to eyeball 5m avg (adjust labels):
```
avg_over_time(kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate{job="kv-runtime"}[5m])
```
You can add `prefix=~"^user-.*"` or `tenant="acme"` filters.

maya: thx. I saw overall ~0.45 for ~20m (unusual). Current alert is a 1m threshold at 0.3 so it didn't page. Thinking: warning at 0.6 (5m, no page) and page at 0.4 (5m). Opinions?

tess: Heads up — we pushed a small batching/hash tweak at 00:15 (PR #4421). Could be related to key distribution. Link: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4421 

oliver: I like two-tier alerts. Runbook here: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/kv-cache-degradation . Steps: check eviction logs (Loki), inspect prefix skew, correlate with recent deploys.

infra-bot: deploy notif — service/kv-runtime v2.14.7 deployed to prod at 1768500900 by @tess

kevin: Loki query to find eviction warnings: 
```
{job="kv-runtime", level="warn"} |= "cache_evicted" | json | line_format "${time} ${msg}"
```
Also check Tempo traces for spans with tag `cache.miss=true` and high latency.

maya: I'll open an ops ticket with proposed thresholds and link this thread. Proposed alert rules: warning = avg_over_time(kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate[5m]) < 0.6 (no page), page = avg_over_time(kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate[5m]) < 0.4 (page). Add per-tenant suppression for onboarding tenants.

oliver: Add a per-tenant dimension to the alert (unless it explodes). Also add a panel showing `cache_evictions_total` vs `cache_hits_total` to confirm evictions spike.

tess: I'll stand by to revert the hashing change if correlation holds; can canary revert to dedicated pool before full rollback.

oncall: noted — if the page threshold triggers, please tag @oncall and I'll follow the runbook.

maya: great, creating ticket now and assigning to @tess & @oliver. If anyone sees a repeat spike, shout here or page @oncall. Thanks!
